What percentage of worlds gdp require chips or relies on semiconductors?


Thought for 2m 49s
There is no single authoritative percentage for this, because "requires chips" can mean very different things.

A strict lower bound is about 0.8% of world GDP. But that badly understates how much GDP relies on semiconductors.


Would it be safe to assume that over 80% of all gdp has a semiconductor present somewhere in its supply chain?


Thought for 2m 31s
Yes - as a loose heuristic, "over 80%" is plausible. As a hard quantitative claim, it is not safe unless you label it clearly as an inference rather than a measured statistic.
